production_registry_check.method: Direct read-only PostgreSQL inspection of all artists and Archive provider labels, including empty/auto-created rows; not artist-list API absence. to_regclass checked retained intake candidates.

hash_definitions.canonical_json: UTF-8 encoding of JSON with object keys sorted lexicographically, no insignificant whitespace, Unicode characters unescaped; Python json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode("utf-8"). No trailing newline.
hash_definitions.ordered_track_ids_sha256: Hash of the UUID-string array in v3 source sets/tracks response order. Reproduce by GET /api/v3/shows/{show_uuid}, select sources entry matching source_uuid, flatten sets[].tracks[].uuid in response order.
hash_definitions.ordered_mp3_urls_sha256: Hash of the corresponding sets[].tracks[].mp3_url string array in the same order; URLs are omitted from this artifact except for the bounded media sample.
hash_definitions.reference_sha256: Hash of object {source_uuid,show_uuid,display_date,track_uuids,mp3_urls}; track_uuids and mp3_urls are the ordered arrays above. The three saved reference digests allow baseline/first/repeat comparison without storing every media URL. Current inputs can be reconstructed from the local v3 API; historical inputs were compared during verification.
hash_definitions.current_ordered_sets: Read-only local source_sets rows ordered by index then uuid. These current set UUIDs were retained after the runs; earlier HTTP manifests did not save set UUIDs, so no historical set-UUID comparison is claimed.
hash_definitions.items_sha256: Hash of this artifact's items array using canonical_json; recomputable entirely from this file.
